## Re-measurement at source, replacing the deleted triage comment

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat · session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S` · 2026-09-24T05:48Z · objectui `origin/main` `62597c5` · read with `git show` / `git grep` on `origin/main`, never the working tree. Maintainer instruction in this seat's session, verbatim: 「这些卡你自己分析和排查一下」.

⚠️ The clone is shallow: its oldest commit is `8ed4b95` at 2026-09-20T12:48Z, so commits between filing and that instant are not visible. ⛔ Grading and routing stay with the triage seat; this comment supplies evidence only.

**Verdict: CONFIRMED.** Plus one reading beyond the card.

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:85-86` maps both `col.id` and `col.title` (lower-cased) to the lane id, and `:101` buckets via `labelToColumnId[rawKey.toLowerCase()] ?? rawKey`. So a record matches a lane by id **or** title.
- Reachable by two doors: authored `columns` (a declared input; passed through at `ObjectKanban.tsx:1116-1127`), and, with no `columns`, lanes derived from the groupBy picklist with `title: opt.label` (`:1140-1143`). ⇒ Renaming a picklist option **label** also moves records.
- Deliberate and pinned: the source comment at `index.tsx:68-69`, and `objectKanbanColumnMembers-8071.test.tsx:203-216` (control at `:218`). Nothing on the authoring surface says `title` decides lane membership.
- ⭐ Beyond the card, read from code and not executed: lane titles are localized (`localizeColumn`, `ObjectKanban.tsx:1107-1113`, plus `translateOptions`). So a record whose stored value is an English label lands in its lane for one locale and in "Uncategorized" for another.
- Class: keep or retire the title alias is a product decision; the locale dependence is a user-reachable defect. `Clause-②: no` (retiring narrows; documenting widens nothing). Size S (document) or M (retire, with a migration note).
